messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: kate@zephyrgames.com, ops@zephyrgames.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: roadmap convergence, launch readiness & triage

Team —

As we discussed briefly last week, the QBR with Zephyr (May 12) is now a single readout covering roadmap alignment, launch timelines for the Summer push, and the most material delivery risks we need to surface to Sales/Customer. I attached a working risk matrix and the current launch timetable — please review.

Top asks:
- By EOD Wed (5/5) please update the risk matrix rows that are in your lane (owner column) and add one-line mitigations.
- Confirm the hard launch gating items you need (API stability, perf SLOs, security signoff, docs) and mark dates in the timetable.
- If any item looks like it will push the public launch window (target w/c 6/14), flag it with an estimated delay.

Notes:
- Zephyr is expecting a concise slide deck focused on impact to their ops and the mitigation cadence; Kate is looped for context but we should minimize external exposure to internal risk details (keep the matrix in our internal Notion link).
- We have a short sync scheduled Fri 5/7 10:00–10:30 to reconcile items; please be ready with one-slide (bullet) summary of your top 3 risks.

Attachments: risk_matrix_v2.xlsx, launch_timetable.pdf

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP Product
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, kate@zephyrgames.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap convergence, launch readiness & triage

Thanks Tessa — quick technical readout from Product Engineering:

1) Quantization compatibility on the offline model fork
- Risk: quantized variant shows a 4–7% regression on long-tail prompt evaluation (seen in internal eval set).
- Mitigation path: hold a targeted 48-hour calc/compare window on 5/9–5/10 (we can do side-by-side serving with traffic-split).
- Owner: lauren.bishop; impact if unresolved: potential decreased user satisfaction with edge-case prompts.

2) KV cache persistence for warm-starting long sessions
- Risk: current streaming runtime loses KV state on pod restart if session exceeds ~90k tokens; we have a fix but need integration testing.
- Mitigation: enable auto checkpointing and a read-retry fallback (canary for internal customers first).
- Owner: marcus.lin (runtime) + lauren.bishop (integration).

3) Non-blocking: model-serving infra autoscale thresholds need to be tuned for predictable p95 latencies during the 6–8pm PST window (Zephyr expected peaks).

I updated the timetable with gating dates and marked the quantization check as a potential 2-week slip if we need a fallback model roll. Will post the one-slide summary into the Notion board before the sync.

Lauren
Director, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap convergence, launch readiness & triage

Adding runtime ops perspective and a suggested mitigation plan:

- Canary + rapid rollback playbook: we should run a staged rollout for the quantized model to a single cluster region for 72 hours with a live traffic-split (1%). If no regressions, expand to 10% and monitor. I attached a short playbook draft.
- Fallback routing: implement automatic routing to the non-quantized model variant when p95 latency > threshold for 3 consecutive mins. This reduces impact to latency-sensitive customers. Engineering can push this by 5/11.
- Observability gaps: we need a token-level cost/day breakdown visible in the dashboard for Zephyr's billing questions; Michael can help scope.

Attachments: canary_playbook.md

Marcus
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick QA / release note:

- QA capacity: We have two full-time release engineers and three SDETs scheduled for the 5/9–5/16 window, which covers the integration and canary verification. If we need extended testing on alternate datasets (Zephyr game logs), that will add ~3 business days to the schedule for environment prep and data ingestion.
- Regression bar: we will run both unit and system-level long-tail stress tests; flagging the quantization regression as 'high' until we confirm the 48-hour side-by-side.
- Docs & release notes: I will draft the external-facing impact summary for Kate; recommend we withhold deeper technical details from the customer-facing deck.

Short note: can we confirm the sync time on Fri 5/7? I prefer 10:00.

Subject: Consolidated QBR inputs + final ask (sync Mon 5/10)

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Two small updates before the prep sync Monday:

1) Decisions we are taking into the QBR (external):
- We'll present the Summer launch window as "on track" but call out a single technical unknown (quantization long-tail) with a clear mitigation timeline and canary plan.
- We will provide Zephyr with a concise customer-facing impact slide (Mina to own).

2) Internal actions (owners & deadlines):
- Quantization 48hr check: Lauren / Marcus — start 5/9, results due 5/11 COB.
- Canary rollout config + rollback hooks: Marcus — complete draft playbook 5/9 (attached).
- QA long-tail dataset prep if requested: Mina — confirm by 5/10 whether Zephyr dataset ingestion needed.
- Billing/observability breakdown: Michael — prepare token-level cost breakdown draft for Friday review.

3) Risks to call out verbally (short bullets for execs):
- High: quantization regression (service impact if we ship without fallback).
- Medium: KV checkpoint integration stability during heavy long-session traffic.
- Low: documentation alignment and external comms cadence.

Links: consolidated risk register: https://notion.redwood.com/boards/qbr-2027-05 (internal)
Attachments: final risk_matrix_v2.xlsx (updated), canary_playbook.md

Final ask: Be ready with one concise slide (max 5 bullets) for the Monday prep room at 09:00 PT. I will run through the customer-facing deck with Kate at 09:45 PT.

Tessa
VP Product
Redwood Inference
